description: Get a pre-reasoned market briefing with trend signals and confidence scores, plus regime classification and causal narratives in the briefings that carry them, for the requested domain (Bitcoin, macro, cross-asset, FX). Includes crypto, macro financial data, and cross-asset correlations (equity indices, volatility, the dollar and Treasury yields as BTC relationship signals). Output is decision-ready — designed to be consumed directly by reasoning agents, not parsed for individual values. Briefings are tier-gated: Free (btc.quick-check, btc.context, macro.snapshot, cross.correlations, btc.pulse, btc.grid-stress), Basic (btc.momentum, macro.liquidity, btc.on-chain, cross.breadth, btc.miner-survival, btc.etf-flows), Pro (macro.rates, btc.full, btc.factors, cross.regime, fx.liquidity, btc.energy, btc.treasury). Requires API key authentication.

date.description: Historical date in YYYY-MM-DD format (tier-gated: Free=30d, Basic=from Jan 2025, Pro=all)

format.description: Response format: markdown (human-readable, default) or json (structured data)

name: get_context
title: Get Market Briefing
